questions_and_answers.question: The student asked 'Erebeetaa wa doko desu ka?' The instructor said: 'ここをいらっしゃると、右の方でございます。 (Koko o irassharu to, migi no hoo de gozaimasu.)' Where is the elevator?

answers.answer: If you go this way, it's on the right.

questions_and_answers.question: The student asked 'Kateeyoohin wa doko desu ka?' The instructor said: 'あちらのエスカレーターのすぐそばにございます。 (Achira no esukareetaa no sugu soba ni gozaimasu.)' Where are the household goods?

answers.answer: Right next to the escalator over there.

questions_and_answers.question: The student asked 'Kodomofuku wa doko desu ka?' The instructor said: 'この先の右にございます。婦人服売場のそばにございます。 (Kono saki no migi ni gozaimasu. Fujinfuku-uriba no soba ni gozaimasu.)' Where is children's clothing?

answers.answer: Next to the men's clothing section.
Ahead on the right, next to the women's clothing section.

questions_and_answers.question: The student asked 'Kamera wa doko desu ka?' The instructor said: 'ここを真っ直ぐいらっしゃると、眼鏡売場の先にございます。 (Koko o massugu irassharu to, megane-uriba no saki ni gozaimasu.)' Where are the cameras?

answers.answer: Straight ahead, past the eyeglasses section.
On the right side near the escalator.

questions_and_answers.question: The student asked 'Bunboogu wa doko desu ka?' The instructor said: 'ここから右の方へいらっしゃいますと、宝石売場の後ろの方にございます。 (Koko kara migi no hoo e irasshaimasu to, hooseki-uriba no ushiro no hoo ni gozaimasu.)' Where is the stationery section?

answers.answer: To the right, behind the jewelry section.
To the left, next to the books section.
Straight ahead, past the toys section.

questions_and_answers.question: The student asked 'Hooseki wa doko desu ka?' The instructor said: 'ここをずっと真っ直ぐいらっしゃいますと、カメラ売場がございます。そのそばでございます。 (Koko o zutto massugu irasshaimasu to, kamera-uriba ga gozaimasu. Sono soba de gozaimasu.)' Where is the jewelry section?

answers.answer: Straight ahead, next to the camera section.
On the left, near the watch section.

articles.text: Directions: The student asks where the places on the list below are located. The instructor (=clerk) answers. The student makes a brief note of each location in either Japanese or English. If s/he doesn't understand, s/he should ask the clerk to repeat, slow down, etc. The instructor checks whether or not the student got the location correctly.
Example: Student: Esukareetaa wa doko desu ka? Instructor: Nekutai-uriba no ushiro ni gozaimasu.
Student's list: erebeetaa, kateeyoohin, kodomofuku, kamera, bunboogu, hooseki.
